name: ProcessValidatedItems
description: Validate a bounded list of nonblank strings before processing each item sequentially with Void; an empty list returns no results.

items.description: Nonblank strings to process; empty lists are allowed and skip processing.

maxItems.description: Positive integer workload limit checked before processing. The example defaults to five items; bind this policy through an Input when exposing the command as an MCP tool.

results.description: Void output for each item in input order; empty when there are no items.

processedCount.description: Number of processed items, including zero for an empty list.

executors.description: Validate count and all member shapes before any iteration.
Process validated items sequentially, preserving their order.
